messages:
Mira: FYI opened PR #812 with a focused cleanup: tool-calling examples, tightened JSON schema examples, and a short migration diff from the old function_call flag to the new tools array. Can @Sam own SDK snippets, @Jordan please add a Go example, @Alex validate parsing fallback guidance. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812

Sam: Happy to. Quick Q: do we want the Node snippet to show both streaming + non-streaming? I think one example each but compact. Also will swap any literal keys for ENV placeholders.

Jordan: Adding Go example is fine. I'll mirror the Node flow but show the idiomatic client usage and mention context cancellation for streaming.

Alex: For parsing heuristics, suggest an explicit tiny example that demonstrates an array of union types and a tolerant coercion strategy. Something like:
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "cmd": {"type":"string", "enum":["search","upsert"]},
    "payload": {"type":"array", "items": {"anyOf": [ {"type":"string"}, {"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"}}}]}}
  },
  "required": ["cmd"]
}
```
And a one-line note: if parse fails, try a regex-based extractor that finds quoted IDs and wrap them into objects.

Cheyenne: I found two broken links in the doc: `/docs/tool-calling/index#examples` -> should be `/docs/tool-calling/overview#examples`; and the archived example gif at `static.redwood.ai/gifs/toolflow.gif` 404s. I'll drop a patch for the anchor.

Mira: thanks Cheyenne. I'll remove the gif and add a small static SVG inline instead. Also adding a short migration diff block showing old vs new payloads.

Sam: pushing Node + Python snippets to the branch now. Node uses new streaming helper + comment about token cost. Python shows simple sync call and a streaming iterator example. Running ./scripts/example-lint.sh — one failure: python snippet missing import for typing.List. Fixing.

Jordan: Go snippet added in a follow-up commit. Using context.WithTimeout for streaming cancellation and showing how to decode JSON responses from the stream safely.

Alex: One more suggestion for the docs: add a tiny "guardrail" subsection that recommends a max token budget for tool calls and suggests returning a compact JSON envelope. Also add a note about nullable items inside arrays and how to coerce them.

Mira: added guardrail section + examples. Also added the migration checklist: update SDK callsite, run examples smoke tests, and check changelog.

preview-bot: Preview deployed at https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-812 (status: success) — anchors render, snippets highlighted.

Sam: I resolved my comments and replaced all sample API keys with process env placeholders. Lint green after the Python import fix.

Cheyenne: Quick nit: the compact JSON schema needs a one-line plain-English summary underneath or people skip it. Added a sentence and an "edge cases" bullet for nullable union elements.

Alex: ok from parsing POV. I linked the parse runbook for the plaintext fallback guidance. Also suggested adding a short test snippet that shows coercing a string->object when the model emits string IDs.

Mira: awesome. Would someone volunteer for a quick final pass? I want to merge today after one more review.

Jordan: doing a quick read now. :eyes:

Sam: final pass done, LGTM.

Cheyenne: +1 from me. Fixed the anchor link in a tiny follow-up commit.

Mira: merging now.

docs-bot: PR #812 merged by Mira into main (commit: b7c9a1f). Release note: docs: clarify tool-calling examples, add Go SDK sample, parsing fallbacks, and migration diff.

Mira: thanks team! Opening a follow-up issue to snapshot these examples into the eval harness and add integration smoke checks. If any SDK consumers hit breakage, please tag me.

Jordan: agreed we should add a simple integration test that runs the examples against a stubbed tool endpoint. I'll file the ticket.

Mira: noted. Closing out.
